Every paragraph S001–S052 is covered. T013 supplies unconditional Sobolev infrastructure, while T014–T017 and T016 split existing subarguments without adding assumptions. Tracing these helpers recovers each original direct input boundary. The revised T014/T009 plans explicitly prove integration by parts and cancellation at joins for the genuine Weak predicate.
